per_question.question: After receiving an initial PCS (Personal Care Services) approval for fewer than 80 hours per month, how long must a beneficiary wait before requesting a reconsideration for more hours?
per_question.agent_answer:
I’m going to pull the PCS policy sections that address initial approvals and reconsideration timing, then I’ll read the full text and check for any amendments before answering.The search found matching reconsideration sections in both PCS policies: 3L and 3L-1. I’m going to read both full sections and check whether either policy has been amended, because the same rule may apply in both home and congregate settings.Both PCS policies contain the same reconsideration timing rule. I’ve confirmed the text; now I’m checking for change notices on both documents so I can cite the current authority accurately.Both PCS policies contain the same reconsideration timing rule. I’ve confirmed the text; now I’m checking for change notices on both documents so I can cite the current authority accurately.Yes. **After an initial PCS approval for fewer than 80 hours per month, the beneficiary must wait 30 calendar days from the date of the notification before submitting a reconsideration request form.**

More precisely, the policy says the reconsideration request to increase hours above the initial approval must be filed:

- **no earlier than 31 calendar days**, and
- **no later than 60 calendar days**

from the date of the initial approval notice.

There is one important exception: this **30-day waiting rule does not apply to a Change of Status request**. If the beneficiary meets the change-of-status criteria, that request **may be submitted at any time**.

This rule appears in both PCS policies:

- **Clinical Coverage Policy 3L, Section 5.6 — "Reconsideration Request for initial authorization for PCS"** (effective **2026-01-01**)  
  [State Plan Personal Care Services (PCS)](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/3l-state-plan-personal-care-services-pcs/download?attachment)

- **Clinical Coverage Policy 3L-1, Section 5.6 — "Reconsideration Request for initial authorization for PCS"**  
  [State Plan Personal Care Services (PCS) Provided in Congregate Settings](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/media/14986/download?attachment)

**Which policy applies?**
- **3L** = PCS in **in-home settings**
- **3L-1** = PCS in **congregate settings**

But on this specific timing question, **both policies say the same thing**.

If you want, I can also pull the **Change of Status criteria** so you can see when someone can ask for more hours **without waiting the 30 days**.
